uniswap-v3.name: Uniswap V3
uniswap-v3.details: Uniswap V3 is the gold standard for concentrated liquidity on EVM chains. It utilizes immutable smart contracts that have been live across multiple high-volume networks for several years without a single core vulnerability or exploit. Governance is distributed through UNI token delegation.

aerodrome-v1.name: Aerodrome
aerodrome-v1.details: Aerodrome is the dominant AMM on Base, modeled on Velodrome V2. Its smart contracts have undergone rigorous audit review by Spearbit. While it features an active multi-sig/governance model that controls emissions, the core pooling logic is highly secure and holds over $100M+ in TVL.

sky-lending.name: Sky Lending (formerly Maker/Spark)
sky-lending.details: Sky (formerly MakerDAO) operates the USDS stablecoin and Spark lending protocol. Its infrastructure forms the foundation of Ethereum's credit market. Contracts are heavily audited, and changes require long multi-day timelocks before governance execution.
